items.name: Dog boarding
items.summary: A private indoor suite with a covered outdoor run, daily activities and food included.
items.alt: Two dogs playing on a grassy yard in front of a red barn

items.name: Cat boarding
items.summary: A quiet cattery kept separate from the dogs, with condos, window perches and daily play.
items.alt: A tabby cat resting on a soft cream blanket in a calm room

items.name: Doggie daycare
items.summary: Play groups matched by size and play style, with three play yards and a flexible schedule.
items.alt: A group of dogs playing with a blue ball in a bright indoor play room

items.name: Grooming
items.summary: Baths, brush-outs, nail care and custom cuts from a patient, experienced groomer.
items.alt: A groomer brushing a small fluffy dog on a grooming table

items.name: Small pets and exotics
items.summary: A separate space for rabbits, guinea pigs, birds, ferrets and reptiles.
items.alt: A lop-eared rabbit and a guinea pig sitting on bedding next to a wooden hide
